scope: Independent commit-bound control review of linked completed-task UI-restoration compatibility only.
riskAssessment: Expanded evidence/control-authority review. The seven-path candidate preserves the original corrective contract, backlog/spec schemas, approved reference and product files, but the public gate can still skip authentication of a mutated active correction and hide its earlier UI implementation range.

findings.title: Mutable scope can remove an admitted UI correction from public-gate discovery
findings.criterion: The complete active correction base must remain selected before a UI contract exists and after evidence-only commits; invalid live admission cannot obtain a no-UI PASS. The bounded maintenance note and linked completed-task restoration guidance require authenticated original/spec/history authority before relying on current scope.
findings.cause: automatic_base and the no-UI validation branch filter through corrective_ui_paths on the current task before linked_correction_authority authenticates that scope against the committed spec. Empty or tests-only substituted changed_paths remove the task from both discovery paths.
reproduction: Create an owned synthetic Git repository using UiChangeGateTests.linked_fixture, with a valid admitted correction whose committed spec includes apps/desktop/src/View.tsx.
Commit a real View.tsx change without the required UI contract.
In a later evidence-only commit, substitute the current correction.changed_paths with either an empty list or tests/desktop/test_view.py; do not change the admitted spec or full base.
Run the actual public tools/ui_change_gate.py --repo <owned-fixture> entry point without an explicit base.
findings.observed: Both variants selected HEAD^ and returned exit code 0, ok=true, no UI files and no contract. Validation against the original full admitted base returned ok=false for the missing contract. Existing taskctl admission validation separately rejected both variants because the committed spec content differed from admission.
findings.expected: The public gate rejects the inconsistent active correction before scope filtering or no-UI early return; it must not hide the earlier UI implementation behind HEAD^.
findings.impact: The public whole-task-base UI gate can report a false PASS for unreviewed UI implementation. This finding does not claim that taskctl submission/completion or independent review was bypassed; those are separate controls and taskctl detected the inconsistent admission in the same replay.
findings.smallestClosure: Authenticate active correction admission before using mutable current scope to classify or omit UI work. Apply the same protection to automatic-base and explicit no-UI validation paths. Add empty-scope and tests-only substitution regressions plus a legitimate admitted non-UI correction control; preserve ordinary and resumed-amendment behavior and all existing authority checks. Do not change corrective_contract or introduce new approval metadata.

proof.inputBinding: The report binds the five executed source/schema/policy input hashes. Candidate HEAD and those inputs were checked before and after the probe. Owned synthetic fixture paths, exact public commands and outputs remain in ignored artifacts; no shared source or HEAD mutation occurred.

sourceCoverage: Authenticated the exact seven-path base-to-candidate diff and inspected the complete affected public validation, discovery, taskctl admission, lease and scope helpers.
The v1.0 correction schema restricts IDs to the linked T01 lane and defect-restoration; ordinary and opt-in resumed-amendment schema rules remain present.

For corrections still discovered as UI work, the implementation checks current HEAD, branch/worktree, full pre-admission base, owner and unexpired lease, committed origin/spec/paused state and prior history, and the inherited human-and-agent-review obligation.

Per-commit checks retain admitted UI-path, intermediate object-type, spec and approved-reference boundaries, including reverted paths. Taskctl adds only the exact task-owned UI contract delivery path when governed UI scope is present.

Reviewed the added valid/invalid authority, scope, reference, lease, wrong-base, no-UI and compatibility tests. F01 identifies the missed discovery-disappearance case rather than reopening unchanged adjacent audits.

verificationDisposition.freshMaintenanceRun: Still in progress when this blocking disposition was requested. Main reported unit/quality completion with ledger checks remaining; this reviewer has not authenticated a final full-run report and makes no full-suite PASS claim.

verificationDisposition.developmentEvidence: Previously reported development passes and RED attempts remain retained; they do not close this independently reproduced finding.
verificationDisposition.conclusion: Do not integrate this control candidate or rely on it to start the linked product correction until F01 is remediated, focused regressions and selected fresh checks pass at a successor candidate, and independent review explicitly closes F01.
